20413.d: Port Sarim is a town in south-eastern Asgarnia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
• Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
• If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
• Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.
• Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
• Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.
• Using the teleport option on the Arc Journal obtained from Sharkborne. Requires completion of Impressing the Locals.
• Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south-east.

20443.d: Portal, also known as House Portal, House portal or Housing tent is the entrance to a player's house, the main feature of the Construction skill.

gt.heading: Travelling to house portals
gt.text:
The most basic way to get to a house is by walking to the portal that is in the location of the house. At level 40 Magic, players can use the House Teleport spell to teleport directly into the player's own house. Using a house teleport tablet is another option that only uses one inventory space and does not require a Magic level to use. Players can choose whether the house teleports land the player in the house itself or outside the portal in Settings, Skills & Experience, Construction. After completion of Love Story, players can use chipped house teleport tablets to teleport to any portal regardless of their house location.

House portal locations

Estate agents can move a player's house from its starter location in Rimmington to any of the other house portal locations identified by the portal icon on the map. These locations are Rimmington, Taverley, Pollnivneach, Rellekka, Brimhaven, Yanille, Prifddinas, and Menaphos. Each location requires a certain Construction level, and the estate agent charges a fee for each move. The details are shown in the table below.

POH Portal Locations 

Location advantages and disadvantages

There are several advantages and disadvantages to each house portal location. Here is a complete evaluation of each portal location to help players decide which location is most useful. Note that houses can be moved at any time provided you have the correct Construction level and pay the estate agent.

Portmaster Kags can transport the player from the Port district, Sunken Pyramid or Crondis's pyramid to any of the following locations.

 class="wikitable"
! Location
! Map
! Notes | Port district | | NA | Sunken Pyramid | | NA | Crondis's pyramid | | NA | Jaldraocht Pyramid | | One way trip. Portmaster Kags is not present at this location. | Nardah | | One way trip. Portmaster Kags is not present at this location. | Pollnivneach | | One way trip. Portmaster Kags is not present at this location. | Dominion Tower | | One way trip. Portmaster Kags is not present at this location.
